curatorWithdraw.title: The curator withdraws shares it does not hold
curatorWithdraw.detail: InsufficientShares(0, 10000000000000000): This address holds no vault shares. The curator has no withdrawal path at all.

skim.title: The curator re-adds only 90% of the support
skim.detail: IdleTooLarge(738550211640646, 9): 0.000739 ETH and 9.00e-18 CVNT would be left out of the pool. A reshape must put back everything it lifts.

fragment.title: The curator splits the reserve over the range cap
fragment.detail: TooManyRanges(16, 14): 16 ranges. A reshape may leave at most 14, so restore always has room.

issuerExit.title: The issuer withdraws principal that has not vested
issuerExit.detail: Locked(0, 10000000000000000): Only 0.00% of the issuer's principal is withdrawable now. This asks for 1.00%.

farm.title: A keeper calls restore on a healthy vault
farm.detail: NothingToRestore(9999, 4000): Support is 100.0% against a 40% minimum, so there is nothing to restore and no bounty to claim.

outsider.title: A stranger removes one of the vault's ranges through a router
outsider.detail: SafeCastOverflow(): That position belongs to its owner: the caller holds no liquidity there to remove.

vaultPays.title: An LP deposits for a tenth of the vault with 1 wei attached
vaultPays.detail: InsufficientPayment(738550211640646, 1): The deposit costs 0.000739 ETH but 1.00e-18 ETH was sent. The vault never pays for a depositor.
